biotools.summary: IndoQCT ImQuest is a software tool for automated measurement of the detectability index in computed tomography (CT) imaging, developed to evaluate image quality. The software was validated against ImQuest and demonstrates strong agreement, utilizing Python 3.9.13 and a PyQt5 GUI.
